verdict.rationale: AI-generated insights are a plausible feature for remote-desktop and IT-management products, for example over session or audit-log data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions any AI, insight, or suggestion capability in RustDesk. Its documented features are remote control, file transfer, chat, session recording, web console, audit logs and a management API, none of which provide AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
